steps.note: Ensure the required tenant capability is enabled before starting the workflow.

args.goal: Navigate to the Vendors page, open the Prospects tab, select a prospect, click the blue Start Onboarding button, choose an available template under Onboarding Template, confirm sending the prospect to the onboarding event, and stop when the screen shows the success state and the prospect under Onboarding in Progress.

steps.note: Perform the vendor onboarding flow that has no dedicated domain step.

args.text: You have successfully started the onboarding for a vendor!

steps.note: Verify the application reports that onboarding started successfully.
Verify the prospect moved to the expected onboarding status tab.
